newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Pioneer targets U.S. funds for Russia equities.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer targets U.S. funds for Russia equities.

text.p: The Russian arm of U.S. fund manager Pioneer Group and broker Auerbach Grayson & Company have begun offering research and trading in Russian shares, targeting U.S. institutions new to the market, Pioneer said on Thursday.

Christopher Smart, director of research at Pioneer First Russia, said conservative pension funds and mutual funds would be more likely to enter the booming Russian shares market with easier access to local-based research.
Auerbach specialises in providing local research and trading in foreign markets for U.S. institutions.

Russian companies, some of which have seen stock price rises of over 40 percent since the beginning of the year, are poorly known beyond a group of about 10 leading shares but dealers say investment will spread to less well known, undervalued shares.
"Attention and a good story still drive the market," Smart said. "Top shares have room to go, but they certainly don't have as much room to grow as the second tier."
Pioneer has produced reports on about 25 companies in the second tier, he said.
